If that fails, use a rotary tool to cut a new slot in the screw head. For severely damaged screws, a screw extractor bit drilled into the center of the screw will grip and reverse it out. Apply penetrating oil if the screw is rusted.

Fermenting vegetables at home requires only salt, water, and patience. Dissolve two tablespoons of non-iodized salt in one quart of water to make a brine. Pack sliced vegetables tightly into a clean glass jar and pour the brine over them, ensuring everything is submerged. Cover loosely to allow gas to escape. Ferment at room temperature for five to ten days, tasting daily until you reach your preferred sourness.
